<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Musical Summons](/Feats.aspx?ID=5421) <actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Bard" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=546" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 65

**Prerequisites**
[zoophonia muse](/Muses.aspx?ID=9)

</column>

---

Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell. You cast [_summon animal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1694) and a one-action [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=559) spell.
name: Musical Summons
